$comment: FND-24 — scoped, digest-keyed exceptions to the repository secret scan (D-CI6).
Each entry drops exactly one finding: the exact repository-relative path, the exact pattern id and
the SHA-256 of the exact matched identifier must all agree. There is no wildcard here and none may
be added — a wildcard would blind the scan, which is why the global allowlist holds one entry and
why PRD-02 section 4 states that appending to it is not an option. The scanner rejects any field
containing a glob metacharacter, and the harness asserts the absence independently over the raw text.
An entry is added only after establishing what the identifier is, what it is used for and which
module owns the file — as this ticket did for every entry below. An entry is NEVER added for a real
credential: a real credential is removed and rotated, not excluded, and its exposure is escalated.
An entry that no longer matches an actual finding must be deleted. The harness fails on a stale
entry, so a rename, a move or a deletion elsewhere forces the entry out and the list prunes itself.
Identifiers are recorded as digests rather than as text because this file is itself git-tracked and
fully scanned: a plaintext list would be reported by the scan it configures. The digest is not
secrecy — the identifiers are in the repository in plain sight, and the scanner header states the
